newsitem.title: UK: UniChem posts offer document to Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: UniChem posts offer document to Lloyds.

text.p: UniChem Plc said on Monday that it had posted its offer document to shareholders of Lloyds Chemists Plc on November 9.

The pharmaceuticals wholesaler and retailer said it urged Lloyds' shareholders to accept the offer and expected the acquisition to deliver substantial synergies that would result in material earnings enhancement in the first 12 months.

"The enlarged group is expected to achieve substantial cost savings and revenue benefits, conservativelky estimated to total in excess of 15 million stg in the 12 months following the acquisition," said UniChem.
